## Hi, I'm Ankur! 👋

Ph.D. Scholar in **Electrical Engineering** at **IIT Bombay**, working at the intersection of **VLSI design** and **machine learning hardware**. I design efficient on-chip classifiers for neural applications, with a focus on biomedical signal processing and closed-loop neuromodulation systems.

## 📚 Current Research

### On-Chip Resource Efficient Classifiers for Neural Applications
*Ph.D. Dissertation • Advisor: Prof. Laxmeesha Somappa*

::: {.research-section}
**Key Achievements:**

- ✅ Designed **16-channel on-chip seizure detector** with adaptive online learning
- ✅ Developed **resource-efficient MAC architecture** for real-time neural inference
- ✅ Completed full **RTL-to-GDSII implementation** with successful tape-out readiness

**Current Work:**

- 🔄 Architecting **scalable neural network accelerators** for biomedical applications
- 🔄 Exploring **hardware-software co-design** for flexible ML inference
- 🔄 Developing **energy-efficient computing** solutions for edge AI
:::
